notes: LT is provisionally treated as long ton; manufacturer confirmation remains outstanding.
Lift datum is provisionally the spreader centre. Trolley support clearance is assumed, not read from the GA.
Below 25 LT use the slowest-boundary loaded condition (87 m/min); interpolate linearly between documented loaded points.
Sensors are synthetic observations. Four corner loads use a quasi-static bilinear load split, not independent constraint reactions.
Positions, accelerations, sensor tolerances, masses and CoG below are simulation assumptions.
Equivalent suspension retains level orientation; no manufacturer anti-skew, wire tension or motor torque model is claimed.
